scope: Demo business rows only. Sessions, agent runs, model calls, and tool logs are not included. Text2SQL answers one partnership at a time; order and sell-out rows carry partnership_id.

coverage.distributor_with_orders: dist-liancai / 联采贸易, 15 partnerships, 33 months
coverage.intentionally_empty: 2026-10 has no purchase orders and no sales reports
coverage.distributor_without_orders: dist-haina / 海纳分销 has 5 partnerships and 3 users, zero orders

handoff_columns.note: Category lives on products, not on purchase_order_items. A pie of category amount needs products.category plus purchase_order_items.line_total (or report_facts.numeric_value where metric_key = 'revenue'). order_lines.csv and sellout_facts.csv already join those columns.

not_in_database.contracts: contracts and every contract_* child table are empty. The demo agreement is a file, fixtures/demo/联采贸易-经销协议.md, and has not been uploaded.

files.schema.csv: columns of the text-to-SQL business tables, including the empty contract tables
files.order_lines.csv: one row per purchase order line, with brand, category, month, and money
files.sellout_facts.csv: one row per report fact, with brand, category, period, and channel
files.rollups.json: 2026-09 category and channel totals, plus status by month; 2026-10 counts are zero
